description: HoldemMath Nash push/fold charts (heads-up / 6-max / 9-max shove and call ranges, 4-20 BB, no-ante and 0.1 BB ante variants), vendored byte-for-byte unchanged. Licensed CC BY 4.0. These are NOT RERAISE-produced solver outputs.

modelNotes.headsUp: Near-exact Nash equilibrium (fictitious play, best-response deviation <= 0.05 BB; <= 0.13 BB in the ante variant).
modelNotes.multiway: 6-max / 9-max tables solve each first-in seat's sub-game independently with a SINGLE-CALLER APPROXIMATION, and fix the SB first-in range to the heads-up solution so tables stay mutually consistent. This is NOT a true multi-way Nash equilibrium.
modelNotes.scope: Chip EV only. No rake, no limps, no ICM. The 0.1 BB ante variant follows the common convention: every player posts 0.1 BB before the cards are dealt.
modelNotes.degeneracy: Push/fold games have multiple equilibria; other charts may differ slightly and still be equilibria (compare EVs, not exact hand lists).
modelNotes.rangeShape: Ranges are pure hand-class membership lists (no partial frequencies).
